decisions: Keep every source-coverage and dependency expansion operation deterministically bounded by depth, fan-out, time, parser/language support, ambiguity, policy, missing-input, unsupported-input, truncation, and rejection limits; a partial or limit-hit result must never be presented as complete.

Carry explicit caps and at-bound behavior for native worker concurrency, retry and correction counts, event reconciliation, evidence collection, telemetry cardinality, and retained artifact traversal; use indexed or candidate-scoped reads for normal recovery and reserve full-history verification for an explicit audit path.

Require scalability validation at realistic graph, task, proof, event, and retained-run sizes, including deterministic limit-hit fixtures and confirmation that duplicate events and exact replay do not multiply work or usage accounting.
